gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p5 (printed p17), 'Transfers from (to) other funds' by fund: General (142,569), Street 10,325, Debt Service (9,497), Rescue 5,000; the JSON statement takes transfers_in = Street 10,325 + Rescue 5,000 = 15,325 and transfers_out = General 142,569 + Debt Service 9,497 = 152,066. detail[] records the General Fund by department from the combining statement pp14-15, gross per department: General +9,497 (index 75), Fire -5,000 (index 76), Sales Tax -186,189 (index 77), Pool +37,623 (index 78), Youth +1,500 (index 79), which net to 9,497 - 5,000 - 186,189 + 37,623 + 1,500 = -142,569 = the printed General Fund column. Plus Street +10,325 (index 91), Debt Service -9,497 (index 95), Rescue +5,000 (index 102). Schedule transfers in 9,497 + 37,623 + 1,500 + 10,325 + 5,000 = 63,945 vs statement 15,325; the 48,620 difference = the General Fund departments' positive transfers 9,497 + 37,623 + 1,500, which the statement nets inside the General Fund's (142,569). All printed; nothing missing or doubled; no fix.

Same printed transfers as the transfers_in entry. Schedule transfers out = Fire 5,000 (index 76) + Sales Tax 186,189 (index 77) + Debt Service 9,497 (index 95) = 200,686 vs statement 152,066 (General 142,569 + Debt Service 9,497, p5). Difference 48,620 = 5,000 + 186,189 - 142,569 = the same 48,620 of positive departmental transfers (General 9,497 + Pool 37,623 + Youth 1,500) that the General Fund column nets. Gross departmental lines on the combining statement (pp14-15) vs net fund column on the statement; no fix.

Proprietary funds statement p7 (printed p20), Water / Sewer / Trash Fund columns have no schedule and no detail lines. JSON business-type receipts = total operating revenues 385,733 + interest income 1,611 = 387,344. Water Fund: Sales 202,455 + Other revenue 1,348 + Interest income 1,399 = 205,202; Sewer Fund: Sales 93,368 + Interest income 212 = 93,580; Trash Fund: Sales 88,562. Sum 387,344 = statement total; schedule 0 + 387,344 = 387,344.
